title: Simple view: chat, essentials and a link to the full dashboard
goal: A second, deliberate layout over the same components as the full dashboard shows only the chat, pending approvals, health at a glance and push on/off, with a link to the full dashboard; it grows from the web/src page (Nodo)
acceptance: The simple view reuses the components of F-130-T02 (health), F-130-T04 (push), F-130-T05 (approvals) and F-130-T08 (chat) and the live data service of F-130-T01; no section logic is copied (later extracted as shared bricks, solution:F-012)
It shows the chat, the pending approvals with their decisions, a one-line health state that links to Health, the push on/off toggle, and a link to the full dashboard; the full dashboard links back
Both layouts read the same theme tokens (docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md); the plain style is the default and EVA is an optional theme in either
A test renders both layouts from the same state and checks the simple one shows only its parts; an unchanged poll leaves its DOM in place; it works at phone width
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 (owner decision: keep a simple view): a layout and route over existing components, the link both ways and a two-layout test. Not a measurement.
